## Project Structure
```
mcp-venus-os/
├── src/mcp_venus_os/
│   ├── __init__.py       # Package exports
│   ├── __main__.py       # CLI entry point
│   ├── config.py         # Pydantic settings (DBus, MQTT, Safety)
│   ├── dbus_client.py    # D-Bus client for Venus OS data
│   ├── mqtt_client.py    # MQTT client for real-time streaming
│   ├── safety.py         # Safety validation & confirmation manager
│   └── server.py         # FastMCP server with tools
├── examples/
│   └── claude_desktop_config.json
├── tests/                # Empty, ready for tests
├── README.md
└── pyproject.toml
```

## Features Implemented

| Category | Tools |
|----------|-------|
| **Read (D-Bus)** | `get_battery_soc`, `get_pv_power`, `get_grid_status`, `get_inverter_status`, `list_devices` |
| **Write (Safe)** | `set_inverter_mode`, `set_charge_current_limit`, `set_soc_limit` |
| **MQTT** | `mqtt_connect`, `mqtt_disconnect`, `mqtt_subscribe` |

## Usage

```bash
# Install & run
uv sync
uv run mcp-venus-os

# Or after pip install
mcp-venus-os
```

## Claude Desktop Config

See `examples/claude_desktop_config.json` - configure with your Venus OS host/port.

## Safety

Write ops require `confirmed=true` or environment `SAFETY_REQUIRE_CONFIRMATION=false`. Configurable limits for current, SoC, and allowed modes.
